description_en: Removes a virtual multi-factor authentication (MFA) device that is associated with an Active Directory (AD) account
description_zh: 删除AD账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备
kebab_example: aliyun ecd delete-virtual-mfa-device --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --serial-number a25f297f-f2e1-4a44-bbf1-5f48a6e50000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVirtualMFADevice

parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The serial number of the virtual MFA device, which is a unique identifier.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206210.html operation to query the serial number of the virtual MFA device that is bound by AD users
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟MFA设备的序列号，也是其唯一标识。您可以调用[DescribeVirtualMFADevices](~~DescribeVirtualMFADevices~~)查询AD账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备序列号
parameters.name: serial_number
